verdict.note: Approved all items. The explicit premise Sigma^SS>0 is a necessary whitening and confidence-region regularity condition and does not assume any identification conclusion. The observed-graph definitions and calibration-graph theorem give the correct residual-diagonality plus coordinatewise positive-definite-completion criterion. In the chordal case, clique positivity and the cited completion theorem apply; the PSD affine feasible set is compact, its optimum is positive definite, and strict concavity of logdet proves uniqueness of the max-determinant certificate. The signed four-cycle is a valid pairwise-observable partial covariance specification whose lack of any global PSD completion is the intended obstruction. Metadata is now supported by an actual theorem, and quotient enumeration remains honestly open.
